{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches contrib/devtools/shell-win64-cross.nix, Guix codesign files, and CI workflow actions to fix Windows Nix cross-builds and CI issues.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves platform-specific build and CI failures on the 32.x release branch for Nix Windows cross-builds."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to doc/man/*.1 and doc/release-notes-empty-template.md are mechanical updates accompanying the backported changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation changes in this PR are generated manpages and release templates incidental to the backport bundle."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/net_processing.cpp, src/netgroup.cpp, and src/torcontrol.cpp to adjust connection handling.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Backports commit 8ec0fd46f4 to prevent normal address discouragement handling from incorrectly affecting private broadcast peers."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/net.cpp, src/rpc/mempool.cpp, and src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp to correct OpenRPC metadata defaults.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.2,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Corrects non-literal OpenRPC schema default hints across several RPC endpoints without altering runtime RPC behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes in test/functional/ are specific area test updates rather than core test framework modifications.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Functional test adjustments follow specific area backports and do not alter the testing harness or framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches build scripts under contrib/ and test scripts rather than standalone developer or operator tools.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The scripts touched in contrib/ and test/ belong to the build and test categories rather than operator tools."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp to fix node shutdown ordering between fee estimation unregistration and queued validation callbacks.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a node shutdown sequencing bug where unregistering the fee estimator before draining queued validation callbacks drops block updates and invalidates fee estimates across restarts."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/script/descriptor.cpp, src/wallet/walletutil.cpp, and wallet RPCs to optimize descriptor comparisons.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Speeds up descriptor lookups by caching and comparing hashes of canonical descriptor strings instead of recomputing strings for every comparison."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
